definition.pairs: 1 <= |j - i| <= 8, at most 40 per expression, seed 0, same pairs for every checkpoint
definition.carries_rule: reference = the highest point accuracy among NoPE (same layer; one seed, the reference for every arm seed), B1p, B2p and B3p, chosen mechanically; carries if the lower bound of (arm - reference), paired by expression, exceeds +0.1 on all three seeds
definition.split: pairs never cross expressions: training pairs come from the 300 training expressions of the stratified split, test pairs from its 150 test expressions; the bootstrap resamples test expressions

amendment.text: H2 order-blind reference = the highest of NoPE, B1p, B2p, B3p, chosen mechanically, all on the same pairs; received after the probe run started and before its readings were computed; readings recomputed from the run's per-expression statistics
